name: 大橫圖＋壓在圖片左下角的直排標題面板
desc: 左側一張大橫圖貼齊區塊上緣，左下角被一塊直排標題面板壓住，圖片下方右側放說明文字，右上方放按鈕；底色色帶約從圖片六成高處才開始。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方不留白，圖片貼齊區塊的上緣；區塊的底色色帶從圖片約六成高處開始、橫跨整個畫面寬並延伸到區塊底部，圖片約上六成突出在色帶上方的頁面底色上。一張橫式大圖片靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，寬約佔內容寬度的四分之三。圖片左下角壓著一塊與色帶同底色的面板，面板約佔圖片左側一半寬，蓋住圖片下方約五分之一高，讓圖片看起來被切掉左下一角；面板裡放標題（可多行），標題的每一行都直排，各行由右往左排列，標題明顯大於說明文字。標題右側另有一個旋轉成直向的小標籤：整段文字整體旋轉九十度、字形側躺，不是直排，它是獨立於標題之外的元素，上緣與標題上緣對齊，可省略。圖片下方、右緣對齊圖片右緣的位置放說明文字，寬約內容寬度的三分之一。區塊右側、與標題上緣約同高的位置可放一顆按鈕，靠右對齊頁面內容寬度，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：圖片在最上方，貼齊畫面左右兩側與區塊上緣。標題面板在圖片下方，左側貼齊畫面左緣、右側留邊，往上壓住圖片下緣少許，面板右側露出圖片；標題的每一行仍然直排，旋轉成直向的小標籤（整段文字旋轉、字形側躺，不是直排）仍在標題右側，兩者仍是分開的元素。說明文字移到標題下方，放在區塊右側約六成寬的一欄；按鈕移到說明文字下方，左緣對齊說明文字。

en.name: Large landscape image + vertical-heading panel overlapping its bottom-left corner
en.desc: A large landscape image on the left is flush with the section's top edge, with its bottom-left corner covered by a panel holding a vertically set title; a description sits below the image on the right and a button at the upper right. The background band only starts at about sixty percent of the image's height.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing at the top, and the image is flush with the section's top edge; the section's background band starts at about sixty percent of the image's height, spanning the full viewport width and extending to the bottom of the section, so roughly the upper sixty percent of the image sticks out above the band onto the page background. A large landscape image is aligned left with the page content width and takes about three quarters of the content width. A panel in the same color as the band overlaps the image's bottom-left corner; the panel is about half the image's width on the left side and covers about the bottom fifth of the image's height, so the image looks as if its bottom-left corner were cut away. The panel holds the title (may wrap to multiple lines); every line of the title is set vertically, with the lines ordered from right to left, and the title is noticeably larger than the description. To the right of the title there is a separate small label rotated to read vertically: the whole line of text is rotated ninety degrees so the characters lie on their side, not set vertically; it is an independent element, not part of the title, its top aligned with the top of the title, and it can be omitted. Below the image, with its right edge aligned to the image's right edge, place the description, about one third of the content width wide. Optionally place a button on the right side of the section at about the height of the title's top, aligned right with the page content width; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the image comes first, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport and the section's top edge. The title panel sits below the image, flush with the left edge of the viewport with a margin on the right, and is pulled up to overlap the image's bottom edge slightly, leaving part of the image visible to the right of the panel; every line of the title is still set vertically, and the small label rotated to read vertically (the whole line rotated with the characters lying on their side, not set vertically) stays to the right of the title as a separate element. The description moves below the title, into a column on the right side of the section about sixty percent wide; the button moves below the description, its left edge aligned with the description.

extras.name: 圖片自動淡入淡出切換
extras.prompt: 區塊裡的大圖片位置放多張圖片，自動輪流切換，前一張淡出的同時下一張淡入，停留數秒後切換，最後一張之後回到第一張循環。
extras.mobile: 手機保留自動淡入淡出切換。

en.name: Auto crossfading images
en.prompt: Place multiple images in the position of the section's large image and switch them automatically in turn: the previous image fades out while the next one fades in, each staying for a few seconds, and after the last image it loops back to the first.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: On mobile the automatic crossfade is kept.
